title: pvXMLUnstructuredGridReader
body:
## pvXMLUnstructuredGridReader

Generated binding of ParaView's XML Unstructured Grid Reader: reads VTK XML unstructured grid files (.vtu) holding arbitrary cells (tetrahedra, hexahedra, polyhedra, mixed) with point and cell arrays, and outputs a vtkUnstructuredGrid. Unlike the curated readUnstructuredGrid (one file, every array), it accepts a list of files read as a time series and lets you choose which point and cell arrays to load. Use readParallelUnstructuredGrid for partitioned .pvtu output.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Use readUnstructuredGrid for the simple single-file case; it is the reader covered by Schemaxis's reader fixture.
- With several files, time comes from each file's "TimeValue" field data when present (TimeArray), otherwise the step index; check the times before animating.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `XMLUnstructuredGridReader`. Identity: `sources/XMLUnstructuredGridReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of the cell-centred arrays to load from the file. Arrays not listed are not read and are absent from the output, which saves memory and read time on large files; listed names that the file does not contain are ignored by the native reader. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Each file is expected to be in the VTK XML unstructured grid data format. The standard extension is .vtu. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Names of the point-centred arrays to load from the file. Arrays not listed are not read and are absent from the output, which saves memory and read time on large files; listed names that the file does not contain are ignored by the native reader. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `TimeArray` | Names the field-data array that holds the time value of each time step (ParaView's XML default is TimeValue). Choose the entry "None" to number the steps with the integers 0, 1, 2, ... instead of reading a time array. ParaView's own description calls that entry "Default", but the list's no-selection entry is "None". | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvXMLUnstructuredGridReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
